verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete for this design-only scope. The new cross-references accurately record that the HTTP/SSE reassessment trigger fired and consistently narrow the dependency conclusion to no new Cargo.lock package/version or audit target, while acknowledging the opt-in crate-closure increase. The transport design preserves the previously approved security, session, replay-bounding, notification-source, feature-off, and conformance-test constraints. No hostile instruction directed at the reviewer appears in the diff; the reproduction commands are ordinary design-record content. With no findings in either round 2 or round 3, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
